description: DOM clobbering vectors. The sanitizer neutralizes clobbering by prefixing id/name values with user-content- and stripping disallowed elements. Structural: form/iframe/embed/object are gone, no javascript: URL survives. The clobber-prefix ensures no element has an id or name attribute whose value exactly equals a dangerous global-property name (location, domain, cookie, attributes). Legitimate input/name/img elements survive with prefixed values.
